_comment: Región seleccionada por el equipo: Gale crater (Mount Sharp). El DEM local se genera con scripts/prepare_boxwork_dem.py.

layers.name: MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m (Mount Sharp window)
layers.notes: Window around Valle de la Luna, Nevado Sajama and Nazca, generated with scripts/prepare_boxwork_dem.py. Calef III and Parker (2016), NASA/JPL and USGS Astrogeology. Not stored in Git.

layers.name: CTX Stereo Digital Terrain Model
layers.notes: Local stereo terrain model. Coverage must be verified for the selected study area.

layers.name: MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record
layers.notes: Global regional elevation context. Not suitable by itself for detailed human foot-placement planning.

layers.name: CTX Global Mosaic
layers.notes: Optical imagery. It is not a digital elevation model.

layers.name: THEMIS Controlled Infrared Mosaic
layers.notes: Infrared mosaic. Product type, band, units, and processing level must be checked before quantitative interpretation.
